title: JNDI lookup injection (LDAP, log4shell-style)
remediation: Do not evaluate untrusted input as a lookup/expression and do not deserialize untrusted data into arbitrary types. Patch/limit JNDI lookups, use allowlist-based deserialization (or a data-only format like JSON with a fixed schema), and disable remote codebase loading. The inbound callback proves the lookup/gadget fired.
